div.head: IV Eg 12
div.ab: Þonne will ic, þæt stande mid Denum swa gode laga swa hy betste geceosen, ⁊ ic heom á geþafode ⁊ geþafian wille, swa lange swa me lif gelæst, for eowrum hyldum, þe ge me symble cyddon.
Ðonne wille ic, þæt stande mid Denum swa gode laga swa hy betste geceosen, ⁊ ic heom á geþafode ⁊ geðafian wille, swa lange swa me lif gelæst, for eowrum hyldum, þe ge me symble cyddon.
Þonne wille ic þæt stande mid Denum swa gode laga swa hy betste geceosen; ⁊ ic heom á geþafode ⁊ geðafian wille, swa lange swa me lif gelæst, for eowrum hyldum þe ge me symble cyddon.

Further, it is my will that the Danes continue to observe the best constitution which they can determine upon. I have always granted you such a concession and will continue to do so, as long as my life lasts, because of the loyalty which you have constantly professed to me.

Ferner will ich, dass bei den Dänen [Nordleuten] so gute Verfassung bestehe, wie sie als beste erwählen wollen und ich ihnen stets verstattet habe und verstatten werde, so lange als mir das Leben bleibt, wegen eurer Treue, die ihr mir stets bekundet habt.

Further I will that among the Danes [Northmen] there stand as good laws as they choose as best, and as I have always allowed them and will allow them as long as my life lasts, because of your loyalty, which you have always shown me.
div.note: Not in the Latin Versio (12 and 12.1 are missing there). Liebermann compares IV Eg 2.1.
